text: Do not go to this McDonald’s. I asked simply for two bacon, egg, and cheese bagels. One with no breakfast sauce. It took them 15 minutes and after the 15 min period. Mind you it was dead when we got there. They took the sandwiches back to double check, asking again “one with no breakfast sauce?” Which took another 5 minutes. Not only did they still get one sandwich wrong but they proceeded to make it a steak egg and cheese sandwich instead of the initial requested bacon egg and cheese. I’ve been to this McDonald’s many times within the past 2 years of visiting Detroit. It is by far the worst. Unorganized. And most time comsuming McDonald’s you will ever go to. What are you doing McDonald’s? Get new staff. Try to actually care a little. Sure it’s fast food but it isn’t even fast let alone correct. If you’re going to waste my time than the least you could do is make my sandwich correctly.
author: The Random Channel

text:
Worst McDonalds experinced to date. Service slow, tables dirty, people hanging inside vaping. Sandwhich seemed like it was thrown together and took an age to come. Self serve terminal told me to pay at counter which seemed to defeat the object of using self service. Waiting to pay people just ignored me until I spoke up after 5 minutes, was told food would be brought to table, it wasn't you had to go and get it when they called out your receipt number. Gave order to me in a take away bag despite selecting eat in. I asked guy where the soda was as I ordered and paid for a meal, he said he'd bring it to me. After 5 mins with still no sign of drink I went and asked at counter guy was busy serving drive through, it was like I was being to much trouble.

Not a MDs I care to frequent again!
author: Noel Symonds

text:
I was very disappointed by the behavior of the manager, Tiffany, during my visit. The way she spoke to employees was rude, antagonizing, and completely unprofessional. If an employee made a simple mistake, there was no need for her to speak to them in a nasty or demeaning manner—especially in front of customers.

Mistakes happen, and a manager should lead with patience, respect, and proper coaching. Instead, her tone and attitude created an uncomfortable environment for both staff and customers. This type of behavior reflects poorly on the restaurant and the brand as a whole.

Tiffany would benefit greatly from additional management and customer service training. Employees deserve to be treated with dignity, and customers should not have to witness such unprofessional conduct.
author: Nefertiti Gatling

text: My friends and I decided to stop for a coffee and a breakfast sandwich, we were told to pull up so they could make the order fresh. The order was a McGriddle with egg & cheese as well as a McMuffin with egg & cheese, after waiting 15 min the order was incorrect and appeared as though it had been sitting around for hours. 1 Star for quality 1 Star for service  1 Star for outer appearance and cleanliness. Overall horrible experience. To add insult to injury the employee said she was giving us a free apple pie for the wait which also turned out to be cold and reheated. Truly under poor management. I don’t recommend this even as a last result. We decided to do a few drive thru experiences and so far they have all been 1 Star, this being the worse.
author: Catreese Qualls

text: Honestly, my experience at this McDonald’s wasn’t great. The service was slow, even though it wasn’t that busy, and my order came out wrong. The food didn’t taste as fresh as it usually does — the fries were cold, and the burger looked like it was just thrown together. The staff didn’t seem very focused or friendly, and the dining area could’ve been a lot cleaner. I get that it’s fast food, but a little more attention to quality and service would go a long way.
author: Jessica
